name: Depth-Coded Color Projection of Confocal Stack
description:
Create a 'depth-coded' (or Z-coded) color projection of the 'Fly Brain' sample stack. 

1. Open the 'Fly Brain' sample image (File > Open Samples > Fly Brain).
2. Use the 'Temporal-Color Code' tool (Image > Hyperstacks > Temporal-Color Code) to generate a projection where color represents the Z-depth of structures.
   - Use the 'Fire' LUT (or a similar spectrum LUT).
   - Project the full stack range.
3. Save the resulting RGB color image as 'depth_coded_fly_brain.png' to '~/ImageJ_Data/results/'.

The final image should show the brain structures colored by their depth (e.g., blue for deep, red for shallow), not just by intensity.
